sonnet.problem: The question asks the baker to fill in the wording of a line (revive me in 'His righteousness' versus 'His holy temple' or 'His mighty power'). Nothing on the earlier cards lets the baker reason to the answer, so it is a wording guess.
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

sonnet.problem: The card says this is 'the third time in this passage' the writer asks to be revived. That count relies on verses 25 and 37, but the card cites only verse 40.
sonnet.rule: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.
